relationships.subject: BzATP
relationships.evidence_quote: phosphorylated Nrf2 (pNrf2) expression in CCD male rats was upregulated by treatment with the P2X7 agonist BzATP

relationships.subject: A438079
relationships.evidence_quote: reduced by administration of the P2X7 antagonist A438079

relationships.subject: BIX02189
relationships.evidence_quote: BzATP-induced pNrf2 upregulation was suppressed by ERK5 blockade using the antagonist BIX02189

relationships.subject: P2X7
relationships.evidence_quote: P2X7 participated in neuropathic pain that was associated with the activation of the ERK5-Nrf2 pathway in rats

key_findings: In CCD rats, P2X7 agonist raised and antagonist lowered pNrf2 in the DRG, with HO-1 and NQO1 mirroring it.
ERK5 blockade suppressed BzATP-induced pNrf2 upregulation.
